description: This file defines a controller pool for managing AbortControllers associated with chat message streaming, providing mechanisms to add, stop, remove controllers, and check for pending operations.

methods.name: addController
methods.description: Adds an AbortController to the pool for a specific sessionId and messageId.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Aborts the controller associated with the given sessionId and messageId.

methods.name: stopAll
methods.description: Aborts all controllers in the pool.

methods.name: hasPending
methods.description: Checks if there are any controllers still pending (not yet aborted).

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the controller for the specified sessionId and messageId from the pool.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Generates a unique key based on sessionId and messageId.
